tasks.label: audit-logo-coverage
args: $data = Get-Content './src/data.js' -Raw; $blocks = @('premierLeague','laLiga','bundesliga','serieA','ligue1','superLig','extraClubs'); $clubs = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; foreach($b in $blocks){ $m=[regex]::Match($data,"const $b = \[(.*?)\];",'Singleline'); if($m.Success){ foreach($x in [regex]::Matches($m.Groups[1].Value,"'([^']+)'") | ForEach-Object {$_.Groups[1].Value}){ if(-not $clubs.Contains($x)){ $clubs.Add($x) } } } }; function Slug([string]$n){ $normalized=$n.Normalize([Text.NormalizationForm]::FormD); $sb=New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder; foreach($c in $normalized.ToCharArray()){ if([Globalization.CharUnicodeInfo]::GetUnicodeCategory($c) -ne [Globalization.UnicodeCategory]::NonSpacingMark){ [void]$sb.Append($c) } }; $a=$sb.ToString(); $a=$a -replace '&','and'; $a=$a -replace '[^a-zA-Z0-9]+','-'; $a=$a -replace '^-+|-+$',''; $a.ToLowerInvariant() }; $missing=@(); foreach($club in $clubs){ $slug=Slug $club; $png=Test-Path ("./assets/logos/clubs/" + $slug + '.png'); if(-not $png){ $missing += $club } }; "TOTAL_CLUBS=$($clubs.Count)"; "PNG_REAL=$($clubs.Count - $missing.Count)"; "MISSING_REAL=$($missing.Count)"; if($missing.Count -gt 0){ "MISSING_LIST=$($missing -join ', ')" }

tasks.label: fetch-napoli-logo
args: $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "https://www.thesportsdb.com/api/v1/json/3/searchteams.php?t=Napoli" -ErrorAction Stop; $json = $resp.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $url = $null; if ($json.teams -and $json.teams.Count -gt 0) { $url = $json.teams[0].strBadge }; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($url)) { Write-Output "NAPOLI_FAIL" } else { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $url -OutFile "./assets/logos/clubs/napoli.png" -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output "NAPOLI_OK" }

tasks.label: audit-logo-duplicates
args: $files = Get-ChildItem './assets/logos/clubs/*.png'; $groups = $files | Group-Object { (Get-FileHash $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash } | Sort-Object Count -Descending; $groups | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { "HASH_COUNT=$($_.Count)"; $_.Group | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name }; "TOTAL_FILES=$($files.Count)"

tasks.label: audit-logo-duplicates-2
args: $files = Get-ChildItem "./assets/logos/clubs/*.png"; $groups = $files | Group-Object { (Get-FileHash $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash } | Sort-Object Count -Descending; $groups | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ("HASH_COUNT=" + $_.Count); $_.Group | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name }; Write-Output ("TOTAL_FILES=" + $files.Count)

tasks.label: fill-trabzonspor-last
args: $url = 'https://www.thesportsdb.com/api/v1/json/3/search_all_teams.php?l=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString('Turkish Super Lig'); $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $url -Method Get -ErrorAction Stop; $json = $resp.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $team = @($json.teams) | Where-Object { ([string]$_.strTeam -match 'Trabzon') -or ([string]$_.strAlternate -match 'Trabzon') } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $team) { Write-Output 'NO_TEAM' } else { $badge = [string]$team.strBadge; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($badge)) { $badge = [string]$team.strTeamBadge }; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($badge)) { Write-Output 'NO_BADGE' } else { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $badge -OutFile './assets/logos/clubs/trabzonspor.png' -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output 'TRABZON_OK' } }

tasks.label: probe-club-badge-urls
args: $clubs = @('Sevilla','Stuttgart','Valencia','Trabzonspor'); foreach($club in $clubs){ try { $u = 'https://www.thesportsdb.com/api/v1/json/3/searchteams.php?t=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($club); $r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $u -Method Get -ErrorAction Stop; $j = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $team = @($j.teams) | Select-Object -First 1; if($null -eq $team){ Write-Output ('MISS|' + $club) } else { $badge = [string]$team.strBadge; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($badge)){ $badge = [string]$team.strTeamBadge }; Write-Output ('HIT|' + $club + '|' + [string]$team.strTeam + '|' + [string]$team.strLeague + '|' + $badge) } } catch { Write-Output ('ERR|' + $club + '|' + $_.Exception.Message) } }
